# Scanner fallback

`zxing-browser.min.js` is the UMD bundle of `@zxing/browser` 0.2.1. It is served locally and loaded only when the native browser BarcodeDetector API is unavailable. Browser package license is in `ZXING-LICENSE`; underlying `@zxing/library` license is in `ZXING-LIBRARY-LICENSE`.

Source and API: https://github.com/zxing-js/browser
